artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan: contract layer (git-workflow.md Never Run + new sibling section, general-implementation-agent.md MUST NOT, recovery.md re-scoping) then a tree-state-blind concurrency-gated history-rewrite predicate in guard-destructive-git.sh, clean-tree test fixtures, standards updates, and redeploy verification.

memory_candidates.content: A PreToolUse hook that must be hermetically testable cannot call agent-system scripts that source deploy-root-guard.sh (which exits 1 when run from the source store) or that anchor PROJECT_ROOT to their own SCRIPT_DIR rather than the caller's cwd -- e.g. task-lock.sh. Such a call makes the primary code path unreachable in source-store test mode and, in deployed mode, makes the hook read the real repo's specs/ regardless of the test fixture's cwd, so fixture-driven cases become non-hermetic and dependent on whatever orchestration run happens to be live. The testable pattern is to read the runtime record files directly and cwd-relatively (find specs -maxdepth 3 ...), inlining the portable liveness idiom (kill -0 on the recorded pid plus a heartbeat-age parse with a BSD date fallback) instead of reusing the script that owns it.
